title: What Sensei Sees
look: Session board: source tiles, an event stream, a code graph and the machine boundary on a dot-grid desk. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion, jade for what stays safe. The Sensei mark on the close.

scenes.name: Watching
scenes.desc: A mentor learns by watching the work: the editor and the assistant, observed.

scenes.name: Four streams
scenes.desc: Folders, git, sessions and usage flow into one local store.

scenes.name: Sessions
scenes.desc: Every session is a stream of events that becomes one session record.

scenes.name: The code graph
scenes.desc: Files, symbols, calls and docs as a graph that a change updates in place.

scenes.name: Stays local
scenes.desc: Everything is stored on your machine; secrets are redacted as they are captured.

scenes.name: Your choice
scenes.desc: Sharing is opt-in: you preview exactly what leaves, anonymised, then confirm.

scenes.name: Sensei
scenes.desc: End card with the Sensei mark: it sees the work, you keep it.
